content.title: Bouraada Housing Development — 250 Homes
summary: A 250-home residential development at the Bouraada site in Reghaia, delivered across seven R+9 blocks with ground-floor commercial rental units and dedicated concierge facilities.
SARL Igloo Yapi undertook the complete all-trades package: structural works, facade articulation, internal finishes, building services, and site-wide roads and utility connections.
description: Seven R+9 blocks provide a standardised floor plate of four units per level in an F3 and F4 configuration, delivering 250 apartments in total. Ground-floor levels are dedicated to commercial rental spaces and concierge offices, creating active street-level frontage across the development.
Completed in 2025, the project was executed as a fully integrated all-trades handover — from structural completion and facade cladding to internal services and site-wide utility connections.
content.authority: A seven-block residential development executed under a comprehensive all-trades contract, coordinating structural works, facade finishes, internal services, and site-wide utility connections.

faq.question: What is the scope of the Bouraada Housing Development?
faq.answer: The project comprises 250 AADL housing apartments across seven R+9 blocks, with ground-floor commercial premises and dedicated concierge spaces throughout the development.

faq.question: What are the architectural and structural specifications of the blocks?
faq.answer: Seven R+9 blocks each have four apartments per floor in an F3 and F4 configuration. Ground floors are structurally configured for commercial rental units and concierge offices.

faq.question: What construction works were executed on this site?
faq.answer: The all-trades contract covered structural works, facade articulation, internal secondary trades, building services, and site-wide roads and utility networks.

faq.question: How is the ground floor of the development utilised?
faq.answer: Ground floors across all seven blocks are dedicated to commercial rental units and concierge offices, providing active street frontage and day-to-day resident services.
